subject: Check XADD element size before creating the stream (#5178)
reason: The change adds one guard to xaddCommand that sums the field/value byte lengths and errors before creating the stream key when the total exceeds STREAM_LISTPACK_MAX_SIZE, a fixed compile-time constant of 1<<30 (1 GiB) that no config lowers. The new path only fires when a single XADD carries more than 1 GiB of actual transmitted field+value data (Valkey itself exercises it only in violations.tcl under the large-memory/run_solo tag, raising proto-max-bulk-len to 10 GiB and sending two 512 MiB values). valkey.action.commands sends arguments as literal bytes with no repeat or generate primitive, a
